He quickly lands a job as a messenger for the Los Angeles Times. But then two white police officers make a small traffic arrest that sets off a string of race riots in L.A.'s Watts district. Since white reporters aren't allowed into these violent protests, the newspaper sends Robertson in to cover the events and talk to the rioters. (Docudrama) - 1990

programme.title: The Parent 'Hood - When Robert Met Jerri
programme.desc: When Michael and Zaria learn their parents missed their prom, they plan a party re-creating the event with music group the O'Jays. (Sitcom) - 1997-04-27

programme.title: The Parent 'Hood - The Peterson Redemption
programme.desc: Robert becomes suspicious of his ex-con brother when things begin disappearing from the house; Nicholas spills milk on Michael's keyboard. (Sitcom) - 1997-05-04

programme.title: The Parent 'Hood - Mother and Law
programme.desc: The tension between Jerri and her mother (Suzanne Douglas, Nancy Wilson) grows when her parents visit for her law-school graduation. (Sitcom) - 1997-05-11

programme.title: Roc - Roc Strikes Out
programme.desc: During a union strike, Roc (Charles S. Dutton) lands a temporary job in Eleanor's (Ella Joyce) department at the hospital. Joey Aresco guest stars. (Sitcom) - 1992-02-09

programme.title: Roc - A Piece of the Roc
programme.desc: No one believes Roc's (Charles S. Dutton) story when he rejects the advances of a new female employee (Trisha Campbell). With Ella Joyce. (Sitcom) - 1992-02-23

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael MacCauley is on his daily commute home, which becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a plan is unfolding, and he is caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train. (Thriller, Mystery, Action) - 2018

programme.title: Judge Mathis
programme.desc: A man says he thought a waitress at a gentleman's club was interested in him; she says he was obsessed with her and wanted her to perform dirty sexual acts on him; he sues her for repayment of a loan, and she countersues for emotional distress. (Reality, Law) - 2020-02-18

programme.title: Judge Mathis
programme.desc: A woman says her friend-with-benefits tried to hit her with his car; he says she punched him in the face, assaulted him with keys and busted out his car window; she sues for repayment of loans and emotional distress. (Reality, Law) - 2020-02-19

programme.title: Judge Mathis
programme.desc: A woman sues her ex-fiancé, whom she met when he was a bouncer at a swinger's club she patronized, saying he is a narcissist. (Reality, Law) - 2020-02-20

programme.title: Judge Mathis
programme.desc: A woman brings what she says is a harassing voicemail to court and sues an ex-friend for defamation of character and repayment of a loan. (Reality, Law) - 2020-02-21

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night - A Love Lost
programme.desc: Sheriff Gillespie's daughter suspects her boyfriend may be involved with the distribution of illegal automatic weapons. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1993-10-14

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night - Singing the Blues
programme.desc: Officer LuAnn Corbin (Crystal Fox) tries to help when her boyfriend (Willie Gault) is blackmailed by a drug dealer (Judson Vaughn). (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1993-10-28

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night - Virgil Tibbs, Attorney at Law
programme.desc: Tibbs returns to Sparta with a law degree, news of his failed marriage, and a murder suspect to defend. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1993-11-04

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night - Every Man's Family
programme.desc: Bubba (Alan Autry) pursues a drug dealer (Damon Pooser) while his nephew lies in a coma from a heroin overdose. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1993-11-10

programme.title: Bait
programme.desc: Landing in jail for a petty theft crime, Alvin finds himself sharing a cell with John Jaster, the incarcerated half of the pair of high-tech thieves responsible for the missing gold. His partner, Bristol, is still at large. Alvin wants only to get out of prison and start fresh with his girlfriend, Lisa, and when the Feds, led by U.S. Treasury investigator Clenteen, set him loose on a sketchy deal, he thinks his luck has changed. Alvin has his freedom and the Feds have found their bait. (Action, Comedy) - 2000

programme.title: Law Abiding Citizen
programme.desc: Clyde Shelton is an honorable family man, until the day his wife and daughter are murdered in a home invasion. He hopes for justice, but a rising prosecutor named Nick Rice cuts a deal with one of the killers in exchange for testimony. Ten years later, that man is found dead. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2009

programme.title: Queen of the Damned
programme.desc: Follows the legendary vampire Lestat (Stuart Townsend), who has reinvented himself as a rock star in the contemporary American music scene. His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat. (Horror) - 2002

programme.title: Freedom Song
programme.desc: Owen (Vicellous Reon Shannon) is a young man living in Mississippi at the dawn of the civil rights movement. Surrounded by racism, Owen looks for inspiration in dealing with oppression, while his father, Will (Danny Glover), prefers to keep his head down after his bad luck with protests in the past. Will expects his son to follow suit, but their relationship is put to the test when Owen starts joining in peaceful protests organized by the Student Non-Violent Coordinating Committee. (Drama) - 2000

programme.title: The Parent 'Hood - Rappin' It Up
programme.desc: When Zaria (Reagan Gomez-Preston) becomes torn between two men, Robert (Robert Townsend) tries to create the perfect boy for her. Tevin Campbell and Gary Coleman guest star. (Sitcom) - 1997-05-18

programme.title: The Parent 'Hood - House Arrest
programme.desc: Robert (Robert Townsend) is shocked when Gerri (Suzanne Douglas) decides to take in a street kid named T.K. (Tyrone Burton). (Sitcom) - 1997-09-07

programme.title: The Parent 'Hood - Curfew-sion
programme.desc: Gang signs and street slang invade the Peterson household; Wendell tutors the high-school basketball star. (Sitcom) - 1997-09-14

programme.title: Roc - The Lady Killer
programme.desc: A woman accidentally dies during a night of passion with Andrew (Carl Gordon). With Charles S. Dutton and Ella Joyce. (Sitcom) - 1992-03-29

programme.title: Roc - Nightmare on Emerson Street
programme.desc: Roc (Charles S. Dutton) tries to find a peaceful means of removing drug dealers from his neighborhood. Tone Loc guest stars. With Ella Joyce. (Sitcom) - 1992-03-15

programme.title: 16 Blocks
programme.desc: Boozy and world-weary, NYPD Detective Jack Mosley (Bruce Willis) draws a routine assignment to transport trial witness Eddie Bunker (Mos Def) to the courthouse by 10 a.m. The task quickly becomes a deadly game of cat-and-mouse when some of Jack's fellow officers arrive to kill Eddie so that he cannot testify against them. Jack sees a way to redeem his wasted life by protecting the affable Eddie from the would-be assassins. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2006

programme.title: Judge Mathis
programme.desc: A married woman says she was heavily medicated at the time of a sexual encounter with another woman and is being sued for repayment of loans only because she refused her advances a second time, so she counter-sues for harassment and defamation. (Reality, Law) - 2020-02-24

programme.title: Judge Mathis
programme.desc: A woman sues her fiancé's mother, who begged her son to stay away from her, claiming she is a heroin addict, for unreturned property. (Reality, Law) - 2020-02-25

programme.title: Judge Mathis
programme.desc: A woman sues her sister, claiming she stole her identity, vandalized her car and told people that she was a prostitute and had STDs. (Reality, Law) - 2020-02-26

programme.title: Judge Mathis
programme.desc: The plaintiff met the defendant online, and they started dating, but three months into the relationship he revealed he was married; she sues him for repayment of a loan, plus interest. (Reality, Law) - 2020-02-27

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night - A Baby Called Rocket
programme.desc: LuAnn takes in an abandoned baby found in a crack house; the welfare agency wants the child returned to its addict mother. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1993-11-25

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night - Little Girl Lost
programme.desc: A woman with a history of emotional problems and drunken driving is involved in a girl's hit-and-run death. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1993-12-09

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night - Your Own Kind
programme.desc: An interracial relationship between two teens stirs up strong emotions when the girl is shot in the back. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1993-12-16

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night - Good Cop, Bad Cop
programme.desc: Tibbs (Howard Rollins) defends Parker against charges he assaulted an ex-girlfriend's (Victoria Jackson) fiancé. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994-01-06

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: To save his teenage son from an unjust prison sentence, a businessman (Dwayne Johnson) makes a deal with a U.S. attorney (Susan Sarandon) to infiltrate a dangerous drug cartel and become an informant. - 2013

programme.title: Empire State
programme.desc: A security guard (Liam Hemsworth) and his childhood pal (Michael Angarano) make plans to rob an armored car. - 2013

programme.title: 5 Guys a Week
programme.desc: Jill Jill is a matchmaker without a match herself; things get spicy when one guy can't contain his bad behavior and Jill's family makes it clear these guys won't get a second chance; Jill is faced with a decision when it comes to two men in the end.

programme.title: 5 Guys a Week
programme.desc: S01 E04 Joyce Joyce is an accomplished 55-year-old divorcee; she welcomes five eligible men to live in her house in the Hamptons for a week, and nothing is off limits; from life-sized self-portraits to a bedroom kissing booth, romance and jealousy run wild.

programme.title: 5 Guys a Week

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

programme.title: Sweet Dreams
programme.desc: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

programme.title: Dim Sum Funeral
programme.desc: In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other. (Comedy drama) - 2008

programme.title: Rodan
programme.desc: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms. (Science fiction) - 1957

programme.title: Hop
programme.desc: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Animated) - 2011

programme.title: The Hobbit
programme.desc: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

programme.title: Fantastic Planet
programme.desc: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Science fiction) - 1973

programme.title: Head Office
programme.desc: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

programme.title: Contagion
programme.desc: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

programme.title: Scanners
programme.desc: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
programme.desc: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Science fiction) - 1973

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
programme.desc: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (Science fiction) - 1974

programme.title: Walkabout
programme.desc: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. programme.desc: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

programme.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
programme.desc: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E05 Mexico City to Oaxaca Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E06 Oaxaca to Chinantlan Mountains Rick Stein's latest travels take him to Mexico's culinary capital Oaxaca.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
programme.desc: S01 E07 Oaxaca to Yucatan Peninsula Rick Stein heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatán Peninsula, a place once frequented by real pirates of the Caribbean, including Sir Francis Drake.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
programme.desc: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
programme.desc: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
programme.desc: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
programme.desc: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
programme.desc: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
programme.desc: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

programme.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
programme.desc: S01 E01 Nisha's family helps her cook chicken dhansak and a Hungarian favorite.

programme.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
programme.desc: S01 E02 Nisha cooks chicken korma and marinated tandoori monkfish tail on the BBQ.

programme.title: Rick Stein's India
programme.desc: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

programme.title: Rick Stein's India
programme.desc: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

programme.title: Rick Stein's India
programme.desc: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

programme.title: Rick Stein's India
programme.desc: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

programme.title: Rick Stein's India
programme.desc: S01 E06 Madurai and Lucknow Rick Stein discovers a five-star hotel in Madurai employing local housewives for genuine home-cooked dishes and enjoys Chettinad Chicken, a dish inspired by spices brought back from both the east and the west by traveling merchants.

programme.desc: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions. (Game show) - 1976-07-12

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

programme.desc: Dos hermanas enfrentan sus problemas románticos en la Inglaterra del siglo XIX donde reinan el dinero y la sociedad. (Movies, Romance) - 1995

programme.title: It Could Happen to You
programme.desc: Un policía enfrenta a su codiciosa esposa cuando cumple su palabra de compartir el premio de la lotería con una mesera. (Movies, Romance) - 1994

programme.title: The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada
programme.desc: Cuando el impetuoso agente fronterizo de Texas Mike Norton mata y entierra injustamente al amigo y ranchero de Pete Perkins, este se acuerda de una promesa que hizo de enterrar a su amigo, Melquiades Estrada, en su pueblo natal en México. (Movies, Adventure) - 2005

programme.title: Seraphim Falls
programme.desc: En 1868, un decidido cazador y cuatro pistoleros contratados persiguen implacablemente a un hombre herido a través de Nevada. (Movies, Western) - 2006

programme.title: Absolute Deception
programme.desc: Una periodista hace equipo con un agente federal para descubrir la verdad detrás de la muerte de su esposo. (Movies, Thriller) - 2013

programme.title: Random Hearts
programme.desc: Un policía y una congresista se convierten en amantes tras descubrir que sus fallecidos esposos sostenían un romance. (Movies, Drama) - 1999

programme.title: Untraceable
programme.desc: Dos agentes del FBI intentan encontrar a un astuto asesino en serie que publica videos en vivo de sus sangrientos crímenes en Internet. (Movies, Thriller) - 2008

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: El padre de los niños que atestiguaron un asesinato revierte los planes de los homicidas que los están acechando. (Movies, Thriller) - 2013

programme.title: Cowboy Up
programme.desc: Hank (Kiefer Sutherland) and Ely Braxton (Marcus Thomas) are brothers and rivals. They're each haunted by the specter of their dad, Reid (Pete Postlethwaite), a famous bull rider turned absent father. Hank is a rodeo clown who breeds bulls; Ely is a brash young rider who won't let anything -- not even life-threatening injuries -- keep him out of the ring. When rodeo sweetheart Celia (Daryl Hannah) gets between them, sibling rivalry grows volatile and loyalties are tested. (Drama, Movie) - 2000

programme.title: The Principal
programme.desc: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1987

programme.title: Blue Thunder
programme.desc: Frank Murphy is a courageous and honorable Los Angeles police officer who is chosen to test run Blue Thunder, a high-tech experimental attack helicopter. While flying Blue Thunder, Murphy and his partner discover that the government intends to use the helicopter for corrupt crowd control and surveillance. (Action, Drama, Movie) - 1983-05-13

programme.title: Runaway
programme.desc: In this advanced society, most homes have robots that perform everyday menial duties. Every so often, one malfunctions, and Sgt. Jack Ramsay (Tom Selleck), an expert in rogue machines, must deal with it. When he and his new partner, Karen Thompson (Cynthia Rhodes), investigate a robot-involved homicide, they discover strange computer chips. Rather than a malfunction, someone is programming the robots to kill. The police must find whoever is behind the murder before more harm is done. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1984

programme.title: Lake Placid 2
programme.desc: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals. (Comedy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2007-04-28

programme.title: The People Across the Lake
programme.desc: A couple (Valerie Harper, Gerald McRaney) and their children move to the country, where they open a shop and find dead bodies. (Movie, Thriller) - 1988-10-03

programme.title: Solo
programme.desc: Android military weapon Solo (Mario Van Peebles) is designed to put down Latin American rebels. But when Solo arrives, the machine feels compassion for the rebels fighting for freedom. Despite Solo's design, he begins fighting for the people he's supposed to kill. When his creators, including Gen. Haynes (Barry Corbin), attempt to bring him back, he flees. But the military doesn't give up. They send an upgraded android into the field to take Solo -- and the villagers -- down. (Action, Movie) - 1996-08-23

programme.title: 7 Seconds
programme.desc: Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-06-28

programme.title: Suspect
programme.desc: Carl Anderson (Liam Neeson), a deaf, mute and homeless war veteran, is arrested for the murder of a prominent judge's secretary. But Kathleen Riley (Cher), Anderson's lawyer, believes her client is innocent. She sets out to track down the real killer, and, as the trial proceeds, makes an unlikely ally in Eddie Sanger (Dennis Quaid), a jury member. When they aren't in court, the two investigate the case and manage to uncover a massive conspiracy. (Movie, Thriller) - 1987-10-23

programme.title: Obsessed
programme.desc: Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2009-04-24

programme.title: Random Hearts
programme.desc: After a plane crash in which both their spouses are killed, Sergeant Dutch Van Den Broeck and Congresswoman Kay Chandler's lives are connected. Their spouses were headed to the same address, with identical keys, under Mr. and Mrs. plane tickets. The investigation leads to startling discoveries and an unexpected romance. (Drama, Movie) - 1999-10-08

programme.title: The Shadow Riders
programme.desc: Mac Traven (Tom Selleck) is a Civil War veteran who fought for the North, while his brother, Dal (Sam Elliott), was allied with the South. In spite of this considerable point of contention, the siblings must work together when they find that other family members have been abducted, along with Dal's girlfriend, Kate (Katharine Ross). Joined by their trouble-making uncle "Black Jack" (Ben Johnson), Mac and Dal relentlessly pursue the criminals to rescue their relatives. (Movie, Western) - 1982-09-28

programme.title: Miracle on the Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story
programme.desc: Injured when their private plane crashes into a snowy mountain, a domineering man (William Devane) and his family (Patty Duke, Elisabeth Rosen) face an avalanche and bitter winds. (Drama, Movie) - 2000-04-26

programme.title: Crossroads
programme.desc: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson. (Drama, Movie, Music, Romance) - 1986

programme.title: Emma's Chance
programme.desc: A young woman forms a bond with an abused show horse while completing her community service at a horse rescue ranch. (Drama, Movie) - 2016-07-05

programme.title: Buddy
programme.desc: Thanks to the indulgence of her patient husband, Dr. Bill Lintz, wealthy eccentric Trudy has already accumulated a large collection of wild animals by 1931 when she is introduced to Buddy, a sickly young gorilla. Trudy raises Buddy as her own child, dressing him in human clothes, and the ape responds with absolute obedience. But as Buddy grows older and larger, Trudy is unable to restrain him from turning increasingly violent. (Adventure, Children, Comedy drama, Movie) - 1997-06-06

programme.title: Side Out
programme.desc: A law student transplanted to Southern California, Monroe Clark (C. Thomas Howell) serves eviction papers to Zack Barnes (Peter Horton), a former volleyball star. When Barnes learns that Monroe is a recreational player, he offers a few pointers. Monroe and his teammate, Wiley (Christopher Rydell), plan to compete in an upcoming tournament. But when Wiley is injured, Monroe partners with Zack. They're underdogs in a tough field of competitors, but Monroe and Zack feel they're up to the challenge. (Action, Movie) - 1990-09-19

programme.title: The Shepherd: Border Patrol
programme.desc: A border-patrol agent (Jean-Claude Van Damme) must stop renegade Special Forces soldiers from smuggling heroin into the United States. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-03-04

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: Deep in the slums of Los Angeles, good-natured Felix De La Pena (John Leguizamo), a family man and armored vehicle driver, is shot in the head during a hijacking attempt gone wrong. Though his wife, Marina (Rosie Perez), offers her love and support, Felix suffers from intense physical and emotional pain following the attack. As he begins to recover, he learns he has been framed for the stick-up; distraught, Felix decides to find the real culprit himself, despite his failing health and memory. (Action, Crime drama, Movie) - 2007

programme.title: Conspiracy
programme.desc: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-02-15

programme.title: Straw Dogs
programme.desc: Married couple David (James Marsden) and Amy (Kate Bosworth) move to her hometown of Blackwater, Miss., after her father's death. They have a plan to renovate Amy's old home and prepare it for sale while David works on his latest screenplay. However, the sophisticated couple's arrival stirs resentment and suspicion among the locals, especially from Charlie (Alexander Skarsgård), Amy's former boyfriend. Tension continues to build, leading to an extremely violent confrontation. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2011-09-16

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: Gordon Jennings (Idris Elba) and his friends enjoy a luxurious lifestyle funded by bank robberies, and they avoid capture by sticking to a strict set of rules. As they celebrate the latest job, a former associate arrives with a daring plan to rob an armored car. The lure of so much cash is too tempting to resist but, unbeknown to Gordon's men, this heist puts them on a collision course with Russian mobsters and a detective (Matt Dillon) who will do anything to capture them. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-08-27

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Miami Mystery
programme.desc: Chalk's Ocean Airways flight 101 crashes just after take-off from Watson Island in Miami on Dec. 19, 2005, killing 20 people. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2010-04-19

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Cockpit Failure
programme.desc: Minutes before they're scheduled to land in Zurich, the pilots of a routine passenger flight can't find the runway; they abort and power up the engines in order to climb, but they are too late. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-12

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - The Heathrow Enigma
programme.desc: British Airways' flight number 38 suffers from double engine failure and crashes near Heathrow in 2008. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-07

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Scandinavian Airlines 751
programme.desc: Two minutes after Scandinavian Airlines Flight 751 leaves Stockholm in 1991, smoke filters through the cabin and both engines fail, one erupting into flames. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-28

programme.title: Mayday - Dead Tired
programme.desc: In the worst U.S. crash in more than seven years, a Buffalo-bound flight stalls and plummets into a suburban home in 2009. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-29

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Ditching on the Hudson
programme.desc: Shortly after take-off, US Airways Flight 1549 encounters a bird strike and lands on the Hudson River. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-03-14

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Mid-Air Landing
programme.desc: Investigation into the 2009 crash of Turkish Airlines Flight 195; just before landing in Amsterdam, the plane mysteriously fell from the sky, killing nine people. (Documentary, Aviation, History, Science, Science fiction) - 2011-02-28

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Disaster Runway
programme.desc: On July 17, 2007, TAM Airlines Flight 3054 slides off runway 35L at Congonhas Airport in São Paulo, Brazil, and crashes at high speed into a warehouse adjacent to a petrol station killing nearly 200 people. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-08-12

programme.title: Mayday - The Plane That Flew Too High
programme.desc: West Caribbean Airways Flight 708 crashes down killing 160 people in 2005, ultimately leading to the bankruptcy of the troubled airline. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-08-19

programme.title: Mayday - Split Decision
programme.desc: Arrow Air Flight 1285 with 248 American soldiers on board crashes seconds after refueling in Newfoundland. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-08-26

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Break Up Over Texas
programme.desc: Near the end of its flight, Continental Express Flight 2574 suffers wing damage and goes into a dive falling out of the sky. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-12-29

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Mayday Munich
programme.desc: A plane with members of the Manchester United football team crashes while heading home from Yugoslavia, killing 23 aboard. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-12-29

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Turning Point
programme.desc: A Northwest Airlines flight cruises above the Bering Sea before problems develop and pilots must make an emergency landing in Anchorage. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2011-12-29

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Bad Attitude
programme.desc: Korean Air Cargo Flight 8509 crashes shortly after take off from London Stansted Airport on December 22, 1999. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-01-20

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Hiding in Plane Sight
programme.desc: In 1978, PSA Flight 182 collides with a Cessna and crashes into a San Diego residential area killing people on both planes and seven people on the ground. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-01-27

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Under Pressure
programme.desc: On July 11, 1991, the crew of Nigeria Airways Flight 2120 unsuccessfully tries to return to the airport after a burst tire creates an in-flight fire which causes 247 Nigerian pilgrims and 14 crew to perish. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-02-03

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - I'm the Problem
programme.desc: Moments before Pacific Southwest Flight 1771 crashes on a cattle ranch in California, gunshots are heard in the cabin. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-02-10

programme.title: Mayday - Nowhere to Land
programme.desc: Pilots of TACA Flight 110 make a remarkable landing on a narrow levee, but investigators must find out why the engines in a brand-new plane failed. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-03-09

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - The Invisible Plane
programme.desc: SAS Flight 686 takes off from Milan's Linate Airport and moments later collides with a Cessna on the runway. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-03-23

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Impossible Landing
programme.desc: A shocking look at the fate of United Airlines Flight 232 which crashed into Sioux City's runway in 1989 causing a subsequent explosion that left 111 people dead. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2012-04-13

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Hanging by a Thread
programme.desc: Aloha Airlines Flight 243 loses part of its roof of the front fuselage before landing safely at Kahului, Maui. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-09-14

programme.title: Mayday - Attack Over Baghdad
programme.desc: The crew of DHL Flight OO-LL must land the plane using only the engines to control the craft when a left wing explodes causing the plane to lose hydraulic pressure. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-09-21

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Out of Control
programme.desc: JAL Flight 123's steering system stops working 12 minutes after takeoff, causing the plane to crash into the side of a mountain and kill 520 people in 1985. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-09-28

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Suicide Attack
programme.desc: A FedEx flight out of Memphis descended into chaos when a surprise attack by a disgruntled employee threatened the lives of all on board. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-10-05

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Bomb on Board
programme.desc: On December 11, 1994, a terrorist bomb explodes on Philippine Airlines Flight 434, yet only one passenger dies. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-10-12

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Mistaken Identity
programme.desc: A high-tech American gunship stationed in the Persian Gulf shoots down Iran Air Flight 655 carrying 290 people when its systems confuse it with an Iranian fighter. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-10-19

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Helicopter Down
programme.desc: In 1995, a chopper carrying 18 people to a North Sea oil platform crashes; miraculously, everyone onboard survived in a life raft. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-10-26

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Death and Denial
programme.desc: EgyptAir Flight 990 suddenly crashed into the sea, killing all 217 people aboard and causing controversy over whether it was intentional or a mechanical malfunction. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-02

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Kid in the Cockpit
programme.desc: A Russian pilot allowed his teenage son to take control of Aeroflot Flight 593, setting in motion a chain of events that caused the deaths of 70 people. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-09

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Impact on the Rails
programme.desc: With its conductors sound asleep, a freight train fails to stop and collides with an oncoming train, resulting in tragedy. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-16

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Express Samina
programme.desc: A Greek ferry, the Express Samina, is pushed off course by strong waves and crashes into a rock formation causing eighty passengers to lose their lives in the freezing water as they wait for rescue. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-23

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Unstoppable Train
programme.desc: A freight train carrying an excess of cargo loses its brakes while descending a mountain causing it to gain speed and derail into a neighborhood killing several people. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-11-30

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - African Hijack
programme.desc: When three hijackers ordered an Ethiopian plane to fly to Australia, the pilot tricked them by flying south along the African coast, with deadly consequences. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2005-12-07

programme.title: Mayday - Desperate Escape
programme.desc: In August 2005, Air France Flight 358 skidded off the runway in Toronto, trapping more than 300 passengers on the plane. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-05

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - All Engines Failed
programme.desc: British Airways Flight 9 falls toward the ocean when all four engines mysteriously fail, and then restart. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-06

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Fiery Landing
programme.desc: When fire erupted aboard Air Canada Flight 797, the pilot made an emergency landing; flames engulfed the plane when the doors opened, killing half of the passengers. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-06

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Missed Approach
programme.desc: Korean Airlines Flight 801 overshoots a runway during the final approach for a night landing and crashes into a hillside on Aug. 6, 1997. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-08

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Mystery Crashes
programme.desc: Mystery surrounds two 737 crashes until USAir Flight 427's near miss gives investigators the information to solve the case. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-02-27

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Panic Over the Pacific
programme.desc: A stalled engine causes China Airlines Flight 006 to go into a deadly spin before crew members were able to regain control. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-09-10

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Out of Sight
programme.desc: A 1986 midair crash between Aeroméxico Flight 498 and Piper Archer N4891F near Los Angeles results in the creation of a collision-avoidance system. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-09-10

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Inbound
programme.desc: U.S. Secretary of Commerce Ron Brown and 34 others are killed in 1996 when their Air Force 737 crashes on a mountain in Croatia. (Documentary, Aviation, History) - 2007-09-17

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Deadly Disorientation
programme.desc: Flash Airlines Flight 604 crashes into the Red Sea shortly after take-off, killing all 148 people on board.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Unconscious Pilot
programme.desc: The worst crash in Greek aviation history occurs in 2005 when all 121 people on board Helios Airways Flight 522 lose consciousness.

programme.title: Mayday: Air Disaster - Invisible Killer
programme.desc: During a storm, a strong gale slams Delta Air Lines Flight 191 to the ground killing most people on board.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Miracle Flight
programme.desc: A pilot heads for a decommissioned air force base, not knowing it is hosting a weekend family event, when the passenger jet he is flying unexpectedly runs out of fuel.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas - Behind Closed Doors (American Airlines Flight 96 and Turkish Airlines Flight 981)
programme.desc: A design fault leads to an explosion on a DC-10 and two years later the same design fault causes another tragedy.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin

programme.title: Bach - 2. Partita für Violin (BWV 1004)

programme.title: Beethoven - 1. Klavierkonzert, Op. 15

programme.title: Martinů - Concertino für Klaviertrio & orchester

programme.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10

programme.desc: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

programme.title: Flesh + Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: The Video Dead
programme.desc: On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!

programme.title: The Incredible Melting Man
programme.desc: Colonel West returns from an historic trip to Saturn with a strange ailment: his flesh is melting! And only human flesh and blood will keep him alive!

programme.title: Queen Of Blood
programme.desc: John Saxon, Dennis Hopper and the legendary Basil Rathbone star in this atmospheric -- and influential -- sci-fi cult classic as a team of astronauts embark upon a rescue mission to Mars only to encounter a seductive alien, The Queen of Blood!

programme.title: Planet Of The Vampires
programme.desc: The legendary Mario Bava directs this cult-classic tale of extra-terrestrial terror when an alien race targets a crew of unsuspecting astronauts.

programme.title: Troll

programme.title: Troll 2
programme.desc: Disguised as friendly country folk, a posse of people-eating trolls lures visitors to their town, and a family of four is about to discover this place is a real tourist trap. Now, the no-good gnomes must be destroyed before the family gets flambed.

programme.title: American Gothic
programme.desc: The family that slays together stays together when six young travelers find themselves at the mercy of the eccentric Ma, Pa and their "children.".

programme.title: Lady In White
programme.desc: When a nine-year-old boy sees the ghost of a girl being murdered, he bravely sets out to solve the crime, but the killer may be closer than he knows!

programme.title: Dead Of Winter

programme.title: Tentacles

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In February 1988, a record store clerk in Sandusky, Ohio, was fatally shot in his van. After discovering a night deposit bag with thousands of dollars in the vehicle, police knew that robbery was not the motive, and began to investigate other possibilities. FBI agents learned that several motorcycle gang members had been stopped nearby on a traffic violation shortly after the murder and theorized that the clerk's murder may have been a botched hit carried out by a gang member.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June 1973, a young girl was abducted from a state park on the Missouri River while camping with her family. Several months passed with no leads, then an FBI agent took a particular interest in the case. Using a new technique known as criminal profiling, he predicted that the kidnapper would contact the girl's family on the one-year anniversary of her abduction. When this prediction came true, the FBI agent noted behavioral clues, hoping that they could lead him to the kidnapper.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1996, a group of political extremists twice robbed a bank in Spokane, Washington, using homemade bombs and military precision to escape. The FBI learned that the robbers, part of a shadowy organization called the Phineas Priesthood, might be preparing for a small-scale war with law enforcement. After the suspects were identified, the FBI was faced with the task of safely arresting a group of terrorists with a deadly agenda.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls. FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper. They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990 and 1991, Chicago police and the FBI were on the trail of a bank robber whose holdups were becoming increasingly violent. The criminal consistently used stolen Japanese cars to carry out the robberies, so authorities hoped to identify him by tracking vehicle thefts. When they finally located the man known as the bearded bandit, they learned that he did not work alone and he had made a pact never to surrender.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1988, new light was shed on the mysterious death of a South Carolina farmer when a criminal confessed that two prominent community members hired him to commit murder. Local police and FBI agents arrested a wealthy businessman and later learned that, even behind bars, he commanded the power to corrupt and kill. Using prison informants, agents had to prevent him from murdering again.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In October 1993, a robber surprised unsuspecting customers by dropping through the roof of a California bank. When police arrived, he escaped from the roof in a hail of bullets. A tip from a local resident led police and FBI agents to the perpetrator. They would soon learn that he had masterminded a local kidnapping, and held the fate of an innocent woman in his hands.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix. The following day, the Customs official was found dead. Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men. Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Amid the cocaine wars of early 1980's Miami, three dead bodies led a multi-agency tactical squad to suspect that a group of cops might be involved in illegal drug busts. Investigating rumors of corruption, the squad uncovered a ring of patrolmen who were making millions by ripping off smuggled cocaine. The investigators set out to prove that even with the advantages wealth and the protection of a police badge, nobody is above the law.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: At 9:30 am on the morning of January 30, 1997, Richmond, VA police respond to a report of shots fired at a local bank. Two masked men brandishing automatic weapons confront, and open fire on officers responding to the call. The gunmen exit the bank, and retreat on foot, eventually eluding the officers. The FBI soon responds, only to find one bank teller dead, another wounded, and the bank's security guard shot four times, yet still alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A man is found suffocated in his Pennsylvania home, his checkbook, credit cards and vehicle appear to have been stolen. Fingerprints from the victim identify a recent escapee from a minimum-security prison, as well as his girlfriend. Investigators flag the dead man's credit cards, and are alerted when one is used in North Dakota. The FBI is called in and joins another task force already assembled because of a suspected kidnapping.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Wisconsin, a varsity athlete is blindfolded, gagged, and shoved into a van by four gunmen. The kidnappers contact the victim's family and demand $30,000, but offer no instructions on how to transfer the money. The victim's family contacts the police. The boy's captors tell his family they have shot him, and will kill him if they do not receive their money. At an agreed upon drop site, FBI agents approach the captor's vehicle, only to watch them flee and quickly be followed by authorities.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A New Jersey State Trooper is shot to death on the side of Interstate 80 near the Pennsylvania border. Witnesses to the shooting identify the shooter's car. Police issue an APB, and locate the vehicle hours later. Fingerprinting of the vehicle points to a fugitive wanted on bank robbery charges. Authorities who inspect the fugitive's home find some incriminating evidence including a box of bullets linked to the Trooper's murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1991, the Safe Streets Task Force, a joint FBI / Washington D.C. Metropolitan Police Department organization, begins conducting an investigation into the violent activities of a local gang called the K Street Crew. Gang members are suspected of involvement in several area homicides. The FBI approaches several witnesses, hoping to convince them to testify against the gang members. Seven potential witnesses are murdered during the course of the investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June of 2000, two gunmen rob a Seattle, WA bank, and flee on foot as officers chase them. One of the gunmen is killed in a firefight with police, the other escapes after assaulting a family and using their home to hide. The family helps FBI agents identify the man, who is suspected of several other robberies. Seattle SWAT teams, working with the FBI, search the home of the assailant's mother, and find ammunition matching that used at the bank robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A California bank manager panics and calls in the FBI after the door to his vault refuses to open. Upon inspection, the vault has been blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables is gone. When agents find no clues as to the robbers or their whereabouts in California, they send details of the crime to other FBI field offices. It is not long before agents in Ohio are investigating a bank vault robbery that is strikingly similar to the California heist.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An Arkansas State Trooper is shot and killed after pulling over a van for a traffic violation. Officers apprehend the shooter, after a car chase and shootout. ATF is alerted when officers find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Further testing of the weapons reveals one was used in a murder several months earlier. ATF traces some of the firearms to purchases made by another man from and arms dealer. They also match silencer marks from the weapons to a third man previously arrested for stealing a flatbed truck.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A Washington DC professor is shot and killed as she tries to get into her car. The killer leaves the body in the parking lot and drives away in her vehicle. A week later, a man robs a bank, and security cameras capture the same vehicle as the getaway car. The FBI believes they are dealing with the same man. Days later, the same vehicle is involved in a shootout with police, but eventually would elude them. Eventually, the vehicle is found, the interior covered with red dye from the stolen bank packs.
